source: async function meta(tab,apply,key){const C=eval(load("ghCoreSource"));const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -c "+C.W.q("import json;print(json.dumps(next(i for i in json.load(open('job-search/wttj-volume-queue.json'))['listings'] if i.get('apply_url')=="+JSON.stringify(apply)+")))"),workdir:C.W.ROOT,max_output_tokens:1000});const i=JSON.parse(r.output);const m={id:C.W.ident(i.url),company:i.company,role:i.role,url:i.url,posting:(await C.W.inspect(tab)).text,channel:"Welcome to the Jungle",family:"software"};store(key,m);await C.W.H.saveJSON("job-search/wttj-documents/"+m.id+".json",m);return m}({meta})
